source.note: Subset only. Brand-replica systems (named companies and products) are deliberately excluded; only generic archetype systems are bundled. Planner archetype labels below are our own grouping, not Open Design categories.

archetypes.editorial: Warm paper, serif or oversized type, hairline rules. MODE B: landing pages, portfolios, case studies.
archetypes.minimal: Neutral, quiet, type-led. MODE B or light MODE A: docs, settings, simple tools.
archetypes.workspace-light: Dense but calm light UI. MODE A: dashboards, admin, back-office tables.
archetypes.precision-dark: Dark, technical, high-contrast data. MODE A: monitoring, trading, ops consoles.
archetypes.industrial-warm: Warm off-white with heavy type and one loud accent. MODE B: bold brand or event pages (closest bundled match).

atelier-zero.use_when: Studio or agency site that wants a printed, magazine-like feel

editorial.use_when: Long-form content, blog or publication home with serif headings

warm-editorial.use_when: Warm, friendly editorial look for a service business

paper.use_when: Nostalgic paper-and-ink look for notes, journals, reading apps

minimal.use_when: Neutral type-led product page or settings-heavy app

default.use_when: Safe neutral fallback when no stronger direction exists

dashboard.use_when: Light KPI dashboard with cards, charts and tables

corporate.use_when: Business app that must look trustworthy and conventional

enterprise.use_when: Dense admin and back-office screens, many tables and forms

mission-control.use_when: Ops or developer console; dark with status colors

trading-terminal.use_when: Dense live numbers, order books, tickers; tabular figures matter

hud.use_when: Telemetry or sci-fi HUD with monospace labels

brutalism.use_when: Loud, heavy, high-contrast brand or event page
